blocks.alt: Darakht numa khaaka. Upar ka dabba Digital Entrepreneurship, us se teen teer neeche: Social Media (Facebook, Instagram), E-commerce (Daraz, Amazon) aur Freelancing (Fiverr, Upwork).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.5: Digital platforms (kitab ki Figure 9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 9.5 mein Digital Entrepreneurship ke teen raaste hain: Social Media (Facebook, Instagram) promotion ke liye, E-commerce (Daraz, Amazon) cheezein bechne ke liye, aur Freelancing (Fiverr, Upwork) apni skills bechne ke liye. Agle teen topics inhi teen ko samjhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Figure 9.5 ke teen digital platforms aur har aik ki aik misal likhein.
blocks.explanation: Social Media: Facebook, Instagram. E-commerce: Daraz, Amazon. Freelancing: Fiverr, Upwork.
